nom: Mario Badescu 2-in-1 Deep Cleansing Pore Strip

avis.titre: Left skin feeling clean, but maybe not for me
avis.texte: The directions recommend using these on clean, damp skin, which I interpret to mean after face washing. When used this way, the strip feels like it’s going to slide around, but I didn’t experience it actually doing so. Then, after I’ve washed my face and left the strip on whatever area I’m spot-treating, the directions advise to flip it over and scrub the entire face with the other side. This step is really satisfying. It lathers into a dense foam and the bumpy side both feels nice and leaves cool-looking trails through the soapy foam, reminiscent of a zen garden. Rinsing it off takes a bit - there’s a lot of dense foam. At the end, my skin feels REALLY clean and my pores are virtually invisible. For me personally, it’s a lot of time and steps to clean my face and I never really feel the need for this kind of a deep clean. But I can see the appeal of this product, and it does seem to work as intended.

I love these!!! One would think this product would be for teenagers but I am a 70+ woman. These strips are great for shrinking pores and getting rid of little blemishes. After using them on problem areas I use the textured side all over my face before rinsing off.

I thought these would be like the Biore pore strips, which dry on your skin and are then pulled off, with all your blackheads and pore clogs stuck to them. But they're not. They're slimy and sloppy-wet and wouldn't stay in place. They did foam ever so slightly, but I don't see what that accomplished. The "silicone bristles" on the other side are no more exfoliating than a washcloth. The slime was difficult to rinse off, and once it was all finally gone, I saw no difference in my skin. I don't understand why you would use these.
I’ve used this brand for many years. This was a fun innovate product to take off black heads. Foams up after few minutes then you turn over has little bristles to scrub! I love it

These Mario Badescu 2-in-1 Deep Cleansing Pore Strips work well! Using them is a two-step process. First, you put the smooth side of the strip on your face, which foams up. After letting it sit for 3-5 minutes, you flip it to the other side, which contains an exfoliating silicone texture, to massage your face. I like using these; they feel refreshing and don't irritate my sensitive skin. They start to sting after leaving them on for about 4+ minutes, but that's expected when I use these types of chemical exfoliating products. These work well at clearing up my face. After using them, my skin is shinier and my pores look smaller and cleaner. The strips come individually packaged. Each pore strip is very wet, and I've found that I can take the excess liquid from the packets and use it as a cleanser on the rest of my face while the pore strip sets. My only critique is that the box only comes with six strips. If you wanted to use one on your chin, one on your nose, and one on your forehead all at once, then you would go through the whole box very quickly. Otherwise, though, I like these strips. They're easy to use and visibly make a difference on my skin.

These pore strips work okay and left my face feeling really clean. These are not the type of strips that dry on your skin and then pull things from the pores. These are very wet and slimy and stay that way. The scrubbing side isn't too harsh and these caused no irritation. They have a strong scent from the ingredients but it isn't too overpowering. I do think these are a bit pricey for what they are and perhaps aren't the best value. Overall I think these work okay but I probably would not buy again.

It has a soft side, and an abrasive side with a wet solution. After couple of minutes with the soft side placed on an area, use the abrasive side to massage the treated area. The pad is small, but you can spread the solution to other areas and massage it until in foams up. Then use the abrasive side on these areas as well. It seems to work both ways. My skin feels smooth after the treatment. It has a clean clinical smell, but it has no fragrance added. This is not the adhesive type that pulls the dirt out of the pores when it dries.

These strips are so different from what I have ever used. You place them on your face and you can feel it start to foam. After leaving it in for a bit, you flip it over to use the scrubby side. I absolutely loved using this and I felt like my nose felt very soft after using. Very unique and I will definitely use on occasion.
